body:
🛠️ Modpack Summary – Fabric 1.21.7+ Performance & QoL Pack

This modpack is a lightweight, client-side focused collection built for Minecraft 1.21.7+ using the Fabric mod loader. It enhances vanilla gameplay with improved performance, visual tweaks, UI upgrades, and essential quality-of-life features—all while remaining compatible with vanilla multiplayer servers.

✨ Features:

-     Boosted Performance: With mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, and Distant Horizons, enjoy a dramatically smoother and more stable experience.

-     Enhanced Visuals: Supports Iris Shaders and Complementary Shaders, with added immersion from Visuality, Glowing Ores, Subtle Effects, and Cull Leaves.

-     Quality of Life Improvements: Includes MiniHUD, AppleSkin, Armor Durability HUD, Mouse Tweaks, Hotbar Swapper, Spyglass Improvements, More Chat History, and Controlling.

-     Redstone & Building Tools: Use Litematica, MaLiLib, and Redstone Tweaks for advanced schematics and automation insight.

-     Multiplayer Friendly: Includes No Chat Reports, ViaFabricPlus, and Server Resourcepack Checker—ensuring smoother multiplayer without breaking vanilla server rules.

-     Customization & Configs: With Mod Menu, YACL, and VanillaConfig, easily tweak settings to match your preferences.

All required dependencies are included (marked as "embedded"). This pack is ideal for builders, redstoners, performance hunters, and vanilla players who want a streamlined, feature-rich experience with minimal setup.
